claims.text: The success criterion is the registered one: at least 70% of the trained INITIAL signs show a Harappa start rate of at least 0.40.

evidence.description: PRED-2026-011 entry: success criterion identical in form to PRED-2026-006 and PRED-2026-010
criterion_arithmetic: denominator 2, minimum passing signs 2, possible shares 0, 0.5, 1

alternatives: The bar could be read as approximate, or a 1-of-2 result could be reported as substantially meeting it.
falsification_tests: Any Spec 036 product that reports a 1-of-2 (or lower) share as meeting the criterion, or that applies any bar other than 70% at 0.40, defeats this claim.

metadata.strongest_rival: The bar could be read as approximate, or a 1-of-2 result could be reported as substantially meeting it.
metadata.verdict_rule: The pass line is 70% of trained signs at start rate 0.40 or above; with 2 signs, only 2 of 2 passes.

The two are consistent by construction: the reproduction judges the trained set and the screen, never the criterion, and the criterion is applied only after the reproduction passes. Neither negates the other. C02 defines the pass line over the share; C11 states how one mappable sign with zero occurrences counts toward that share. The two are consistent by construction: C11 supplies one sign's contribution to the quantity C02 judges. Neither negates the other. C02 defines the criterion; C12 states that the per-sign table is descriptive and carries no criterion. The two are consistent by construction: the table reports the quantities the criterion judges and moves no verdict itself. Neither negates the other.

claims.text: The score is the share of trained signs whose Harappa start rate is at least 0.40.

evidence.description: PRED-2026-011 entry: a sign's start rate is the share of its Harappa occurrences, counted through its best-match counterpart glyphs, in which it is the first sign of a sequence
Analysis plan as filed: count every occurrence of the counterpart glyphs in Harappa sequences; initial when the glyph is the first token; a one-sign sequence counts its only sign as initial

alternatives: Start rates could be computed over all Yajnadevam sites, pooled with training counts, or adjusted for composition.
falsification_tests: Any Spec 036 product whose share is computed on anything other than the withheld Harappa sequences, or with a start rate defined otherwise than initial occurrences over total occurrences through counterpart glyphs, defeats this claim.
